title: Lord's paradox: Wainer-Brown revision
content: Initial Weight affects Diet assignment and Final Weight, while Diet affects Final Weight. Gain is deterministically Final Weight minus Initial Weight. Initial Weight is therefore a confounder of the Diet-to-Gain effect and must be adjusted for.

variables.name: Diet
variables.content: The treatment whose total effect on weight gain is sought.

variables.name: Initial Weight
variables.content: The common cause of Diet assignment and Gain.

variables.name: Final Weight
variables.content: Final weight after the diet period.

variables.name: Gain
variables.content: The deterministic outcome Y = Final Weight - Initial Weight.
